All existing runs on the seeded test account are status=pending. (c) Verified all standalone modules load with HTTP 200 and no new JS errors: /plant-database, /target-prediction, /compound-target-prediction, /disease-target-prediction, /network-analysis, /molecular-docking, /dock, /admet — none broken by the chat-only card changes (expected, since publicationExport.js is a new file and only NetworkCard/CTPNetworkCard/EnrichmentCard/_helpers.jsx were touched, none of which are imported by standalone module pages).

The pending run on project TEST_iter54_metering (id 6a760759db0225dab908e94c) already has a full 8-step plan queued — clicking 'Run plan' would exercise all three cards in one go (~5-10 min including docking; can shorten by editing the plan to drop the docking step).

(Pre-existing, unrelated) There is a React hydration warning `In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>` seen while loading standalone pages. Not introduced by this iteration but worth cleaning up in a future pass.
critical_code_review_comments: NetworkCard.jsx: layout switched from cose to concentric with concentric fn (compound=ring 1, target=ring 2+degree), minNodeSpacing:26, avoidOverlap:true, nodeDimensionsIncludeLabels:true — bipartite non-overlap guarantee satisfied. Compound style shape='hexagon' fill #5139ED; target style shape='ellipse' fill #2BB673. Legend shows both. Publication PNG button has testid=network-download-publication-png and invokes downloadCytoscapePublicationPng correctly. ✔

CTPNetworkCard.jsx: 3-tier concentric layout — Pathway (ring 3), Target (ring 2), Compound (ring 1) — avoidOverlap+labels+22px min spacing. Shapes hexagon/ellipse/diamond per type; edge tinting for involved_in edges. Legend row lists 'Compounds (hexagons)', 'Targets (ellipses)', 'Pathways (diamonds)'. Publication PNG button testid=ctp-download-publication-png wired to downloadCytoscapePublicationPng. Click-to-isolate + slider filters preserved. ✔

EnrichmentCard.jsx: styleForSource() maps kegg->circle+purple, bp->square+green, mf->triangle+amber, cc->diamond+rose (with sensible fallbacks). ShapeMarker helper draws rect/path/circle. Bubble view now renders shapes+colours per source AND a legend row (dedup source list, plotted at y=h-26). Lollipop uses same styleForSource for line stroke + terminal marker. Sankey untouched (per scope). ✔

_helpers.jsx ChartDownloadBar: adds third button `data-testid=chart-download-publication-png-{filenameBase}`, calls downloadSvgAsPublicationPng(get(), *_publication.png, 3). Existing SVG/PNG buttons unchanged. ✔

publicationExport.js: downloadCytoscapePublicationPng saves original style via cy.style().json(), applies white-bg publication style (hex Compound + ellipse Target + diamond Pathway with white text-outline and dark text), exports at scale=3 with bg=#FFFFFF, then finally-restores the original style — try/finally guarantees restoration even on export failure. downloadSvgAsPublicationPng clones SVG, walks all fill/stroke/color attributes AND inline style, remapping dark-theme colours via COLOR_REMAP + regex for rgba(255,255,255,α) grid lines, sets clone bg white, rasterises at 3x DPI on a white canvas. ✔

Shape-CSS-vs-attribute mismatch: EnrichmentCard's Bubble/Lollipop use CSS attribute rotate-45 for the diamond swatches in the header — but SVG shape rendering uses the ShapeMarker path fn (correct). No functional bug.

Restore-safety nit: In downloadCytoscapePublicationPng, `originalStyle = cy.style().json()` returns the array of style rules, and `fromJson(originalStyle).update()` reapplies them — this is the documented cytoscape API and correct. If the caller had per-node overrides applied via `.style('...')`, those would still be lost. For the current chat-workflow use case (only stylesheet-level styles) this is fine.
downloadSvgAsPublicationPng: `img.onerror` revokes URL but doesn't surface a user-visible error — acceptable since it silently no-ops.
None of the three modified card files are imported by any standalone module page — verified via grep of /app/frontend/src/pages/*. Scope confinement to chat-workflow is respected. ✔

downloadCytoscapePublicationPng: opts.scale defaults to 3 but not user-configurable from the UI — fine for MVP; downloadSvgAsPublicationPng is called with a hard-coded scale=3 too. Publication-print at 300 DPI matches standard journal figure requirements.
